description_en: Modifies the strict mode configuration, including whether to enable alerting in strict mode. This is a full-update operation
description_zh: 用户修改严格模式配置，选择严格模式下的告警是否打开，该接口为全量接口
name: UpdateStrictEventName

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The operator for the rule action. Valid values:
on: enables alerting
off: disables alerting
parameters.help_zh:
操作规则判定操作符：
on：打开告警
off：关闭告警
parameters.name: operator

parameters.help_en:
The list of strict mode alerts to operate on. This is a full list. Strict mode alerts not included in this list will have the opposite action applied.
Call [DescribeStrictEventName](~~DescribeStrictEventName~~) to obtain the list of all strict mode alerts.
-
parameters.help_zh:
需要操作的严格告警列表，该列表为全量列表，列表未包含的严格告警将执行此次的相反操作。
您可以调用[DescribeStrictEventName](~~DescribeStrictEventName~~)获取所有严格模式的告警列表。
-
parameters.name: event_name_list

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request. You can use it to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
